title: bored at work, letme try some of your guys game
author: adam20101
selftext: like the title says, im bored at work. i want to play some games. ill give some small feedbacks if i have them. send me a link and ill play it(maybe)

replies.author: adam20101
replies.body:
the mechanics of the game is just unplayable for me. the movement is very weird, the direction of the movement sometimes follows the camera, sometimes doesnt. 

and then the UI, every time i change an option it reloads the page, just bad UX for me.

but the game mechanic is the most important part of the game, so focus on the movement, how the camera interacts with the movement. the movement should be predictable where users dont have to guess where to look to make sure they go the right direction.
